text: Clone repositories by URL over https, ssh, git, and http protocols
quote: Press + on the list of repositories and provide a URL pointing to your repository. Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols.

text: Turn a directory copied into the Files app location into a new repository with all its files added
quote: If the directory does not contain a .git subdirectory at top-level, Working Copy assumes you want a new repository with all these files added.

text: Show source files with syntax highlighting and preview HTML and document files
quote: File content is shown with syntax highlighting for sourcecode and a preview of html and document files.

text: Preview reloads automatically when the file or its local assets change, keeping scroll and zoom
quote: The preview reloads automatically when the file or any local asset it depends on changes, restoring scroll and zoom

text: Commit file modifications from the Status tab
quote: When you have file modifications the Changes tab lights up... you can commit them to the repository with a button on the Status tab.

text: Commit while offline and push later, because commit and push are separate actions
quote: Because Commit and Push are distinct actions you can Commit while offline and Push once you get back online.

text: Suggest commit messages with AI by sending staged diffs to OpenAI
quote: includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence. These AI suggestions require sending staged differences to OpenAI

text: AI features such as the Code Agent and commit suggestions are opt-in to protect user data
quote: Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.

text: Set a repository to rebase instead of merge when integrating commits
quote: You can configure repositories to _Rebase_ instead of _Merge_ commits from the Configuration page inside Repository status.

text: Resolve merge conflicts across many files at once with a Resolve tool
quote: A faster solution is to use the Resolve tool that lets you resolve conflicts for many files at once.

text: Store SSH keys in the Secure Enclave, protected by Face ID or Touch ID
quote: For extra security SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID.

text: Work with private instances of GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, and Gitea
quote: Working Copy supports private instances of GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea.

text: Search within a file using regular expressions wrapped in slashes
quote: Regular expression search is supported for the file scope by wrapping your pattern in slashes such as /[0-9]+/ to find all integers.

text: Search across filenames, symbols, line numbers, and text, with fuzzy matching for filenames and symbols
quote: Search queries will be matched against filenames, symbols, line numbers and text content. For filenames and symbols a fuzzy matching will be performed

text: Compare image changes side by side, with zoom kept in sync between the two images
quote: Image changes can be viewed in a split-mode where zooming one image will make the other one follow - making it easy to focus on the details.

text: Image diff Color mode highlights changed areas in green
quote: use the Color mode that highlights changed areas in green where identical areas are without color.

text: Annotate documents by drawing freehand or by highlighting, underlining, striking through, or adding notes
quote: Tap _Annotate_ to draw freehand with Apple Pencil or your finger, or select text to highlight, underline, strike through or add a note.

text: Check out an old version by swiping on a commit
quote: Swipe left on any commit in the repository's commit list to Checkout an old version.

text: Undo unpushed commits, keeping their changes as modified files
quote: For commits not yet pushed to a remote, swipe left to Undo them. The commit's changes remain in your working directory as modified files

text: Amend the latest commit from the commit dialog
quote: To make changes to the latest commit enable Amend at the top of the commit dialog.

text: Delete a commit, edit a commit message, or squash a commit with its child
quote: Long tapping commits you can Delete Commit to rewrite the branch without the work contributed by this single commit, Edit Message to change a commit message... or Squash a commit with its child.

text: Explore changes across branches in a Commit Graph
quote: To explore repository changes across branches use the Commit Graph available from the Repository screen.

text: Create pull requests for BitBucket, GitHub, and GitLab
quote: Working Copy supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab.

text: Import a private key or generate one in the app and attach it to an identity
quote: You attach a private key to your Identity which can be imported or generated inside the app.

text: List and create tags from the repository status screen
quote: View the list of tags from the Repository status screen creating new tags by tapping + in the upper right corner.

text: Stash and unstash changes from the repository context menu
quote: You Stash and Unstash from the context menu of repositories.

text: Support Git submodules inside repositories
quote: Git submodules allow you to include other Git repositories within your repository, keeping their histories separate.

text: Make all repositories available in the Files app and to other apps through the document picker
quote: All repositories in Working Copy can be accessed in the Files app and 3rd party applications using the document picker or file browser components.

text: Drag files from email, Files, or other apps into repositories
quote: Drag files from your emails, the Files app or any other supporting app to add to your repositories.

text: Link an external folder or Document Package from the Files app as a repository
quote: When adding repositories you tap Link external directory and pick a folder or Document Package in the Files app.

text: Move files into and out of the app with a built-in WebDAV server
quote: a good way to get files into and out of Working Copy is the built-in WebDAV server.

text: Automate the app with the Shortcuts app
quote: Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.

text: Automate the app with x-callback-url
quote: Use Shortcuts and x-callback-url for automation.

text: Converse with a Repository Agent AI that browses, searches, reads and modifies files, and commits, pulls, and pushes
quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.

text: Stage or unstage individual hunks so only some changes in a file are committed
quote: When looking at differences you can stage/unstage individual hunks by long-tapping and swiping making it possible to commit some changes in a file but leave others uncommitted.

text: Auto-Sync commits, pulls, and pushes automatically whenever changes are detected
quote: Auto-Sync does all of this for you, committing, pulling and pushing whenever changes are detected.

text: Background Sync keeps syncing while you use other apps
quote: Turn on _Background Sync_ to keep syncing while you use other apps, which uses your location and extra battery and pauses after long periods without changes.

text: JavaScript Console shows errors, warnings, and logs, and tapping an error jumps to its line
quote: Enable the JavaScript Console to check for errors, warnings and log statements: errors in repository scripts can be tapped to jump to the line

text: Open previews from other devices or computers through an External URL
quote: You can also preview from other devices or computers by enabling External URL.

text: Handle videos and other large assets with Git LFS
quote: Use Git LFS to efficiently handle videos and other huge assets.

text: Clone full repositories so they are available offline
quote: Clone repositories making them fully available even when offline.

text: Sign commits
quote: Take part in secure workflows by signing commits.

text: Work with AWS CodeCommit through an IAM user with SSH keys
quote: To use Working Copy with AWS CodeCommit you need to create an IAM user with the IAMUserSSHKeys Policy.

text: List your repositories on GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab, and other hosts to pick one and clone
quote: There is special support for GitHub, BitBucket, GitLab and other hosting providers to list your available repositories, making cloning as simple as picking a repository and tapping clone.

text: Fetch all repositories at once and merge every repository with new commits in one tap
quote: You can pull the list of repositories down to Fetch for all your repositories. If any of your repositories received new commits you will be able to Merge all these repositories with a single tap.

text: On iPad, drag the repository status sheet into its own window
quote: On iPad the fingerprint button can be dragged into a new window to show the repository status sheet

text: Register your public key automatically with BitBucket or GitHub when connecting
quote: If you tap "Connect with BitBucket" or "Connect with GitHub" your public key will automatically be registered with BitBucket or GitHub.

text: Use a Linux server, BSD server, or Synology NAS as a hosting provider via SSH
quote: configure a regular Linux server, BSD server & Synology NAS to act as a hosting provider, using SSH commands for listing repositories.

text: Adjust CSS colors in the editor and pick them with a color picker
quote: When your selection matches a valid CSS color you can adjust this. Placing the caret where a color is expected the popup menu also lets you use a color picker.

text: Choose from the included editor fonts or import OpenType/TrueType fonts (Pro)
quote: You can pick between a number of included fonts or import new OpenType or TrueType fonts as a pro feature.
